maya: RC built from main: rc-2026-03-20-1. Artifacts at s3://redwood-rcs/rc-2026-03-20-1.tar.gz. Creating this thread for sign-off and pinning. Change window 10:00-11:00 UTC 2026-03-21. Please ack or raise blockers.
alex: quick check — smoke tests locally passed. Canary image on staging looks good.
lucas: noted KV cache TTL tweak in this RC; watch memory pressure. I ran load test 10k qps for 5m, 95th latency +4ms, looks fine.
deploy-bot: pre-promotion checks:
 - infra-health: OK
 - canary-smoke: OK
 - open-alerts: 0
 - pinned-model-versions: none
Status: READY
maya: request: pin model to `model-retro-v2.1-quant` for this RC, fallback `model-retro-v2.0`.
alex: agree with pin. Also add feature flag `enable-kv-prefetch=false` to roll out later.
priya: I'll update release notes: mention quant changes, the KV TTL tweak, and rollback commands. Draft link: https://go/release-notes/rc-2026-03-20-1
tess: holding until SSO incident is fully cleared? CC'ing ops.
ops-ci: SSO incident cleared 2h ago, no regressions observed. Good to proceed if on-call signoff.
maya: on-call signoff @alex ?
alex: oncall ok from me. +1 :thumbsup: 
maya: planning promotion at 10:05 UTC, 10m canary then sweep. Rollback plan: tag `rc-2026-03-20-1` -> `rollback-to-main` and restore model pin to `model-retro-v2.0`. Keep 30m observation.
deploy-bot: scheduling rollout: `deploy promote rc-2026-03-20-1 --canary=10% --duration=10m --sweep=100%`
lucas: logging patch included; prod logs will include `kv_cache.prefetch=false` in metadata.
priya: release notes updated & docs link posted.
maya: final: votes? If no objections we'll promote at 10:05 UTC.
alex: no objections here.
lucas: no objections.
tess: ok from me.
maya: thanks everyone — promoting now.
deploy-bot: starting promotion. canary 10% at 10:05 UTC...
deploy-bot: canary checks passed. sweeping to 100%.
deploy-bot: promotion complete. prod version: rc-2026-03-20-1. Monitor for 30m.
maya: monitor channels open, will escalate on anomalies. closing thread once 30m clean.
